cameraCalibration.loadFailed: The camera picture could not be loaded.
cameraCalibration.perspectiveHelp: Drag the four corners onto the corners of the sheet or desk. The arrow keys move the selected corner by one pixel, with Shift by ten.
cameraCalibration.cropHelp: Drag the frame or its handles to choose the part of the picture to keep. The arrow keys move it, Shift + arrow keys resize it.
cameraCalibration.invalidQuad: The corners cross, lie on one line or form a dented (not convex) shape. Move them into a convex four-sided shape to apply.
